title: One row of Docs/licenses.csv (the merged 19-column licence ledger, ARCHITECTURE §3.13)
description: CSV values are strings; a validator parses the CSV (lib/csv.mjs parseCsv) and validates each row object against this schema. x-columns is the exact header order. Only Tools/kit/ship/license_row.mjs writes rows. Policy checks (deny lists, free tiers, DRM, Quaternius dates…) live in licenses_check.mjs, not here. $defs: release (Docs/ship/release.json), packedAssets (Builds/<dir>/packed_assets.json from BuildReportExport). Contract: CONTRACTS.md §7.6.

path.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path of the file (or folder ending in /) the row covers.

sha256.description: sha256 of the file when the row was written; empty only for folders or unclassified imports.

source_kind.description: own_account_download = e.g. Mixamo through the user's own Adobe ID; imported_unknown = KNOTWELL migration rows not yet classified.

licence_id.description: SPDX id where one exists (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, MIT, OFL-1.1) or a kit id (OGA-BY-3.0, QAL-1.0, Pixabay-Content-License, Sonniss-GDC, Mixamo-Adobe, Own-Work, AI-generated:<provider>:<endpoint>, Unknown).

account_or_plan.description: Provider plan at generation or download time (free, pro, starter, enterprise_music, …); empty when not applicable.

generator_model.description: Endpoint or model id, e.g. fal-ai/nano-banana-pro, music_v2_5.

commercial_ok.description: unknown fails the ship gate until a human classifies it.

ships.description: Intent only; the ship scope is decided by the BuildReport join.

platforms.description: e.g. steam-win64, itch; the ElevenLabs Music rule counts entries.

steam_drm_wrapper.description: true fails any CC-BY row in the ship scope.

public_repo.description: true fails redistribution=forbidden and embedded_only raw files in the repo.

packed.description: BuildReport.packedAssets: one entry per PackedAssets (serialized file).

source_asset_path.description: PackedAssetInfo.sourceAssetPath, e.g. Assets/Art/Frog.fbx (may be a built-in resource path).

files.description: BuildReport.GetFiles(): every file in the output (DLLs, plugins, StreamingAssets); build_join also rescans the folder.
